problem:
Which of the following statements are true regarding the finite region bounded between the circle ${x}^{2}+{y}^{2}=4$ and the ellipse $4{x}^{2}+(y+1)^{2}=1?$

- It is a type I region
- It is a type II region
- It's neither a type I nor a type II region
worked_solution:
First, let's sketch our region.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14038811/assets/bc6b71d1fe69abd34dbd939dc62ede5201b75713e25456cf084e889bc44f449e.png)

We have the following:

- The vertical line $x=0.4$ intersects the region in two separate intervals, as shown below. So, this can't be a type I region.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14038811/assets/4a1fd7069abaa3b3fa4d9c286773d226798bf3ad565e85663cab44557fd635c1.png)

- The horizontal line $y=-1$ intersects the region in two separate intervals, as shown below. So, this can't be a type II region.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14038811/assets/260e8e959ca95a029a98bd4102106a66df418ea73c0640398c8fdebfdbf812f6.png)

Therefore, only statement III is true.
